title: Polypropylene skid and loop fabrication | Aquemi
meta: Polypropylene skids and loops for a Purified Water package: each product-contact joint numbered and logged with its welder, settings and material lot.
headline: Trace any joint back to its welder and material
lead: We build the polypropylene (PP) skids and loops of our Purified Water (PW) package. Each product-contact joint is numbered and logged with its welder, settings and material.

blocks.intro: A joint inside a finished skid is hard to re-inspect.

items.q: Can we audit the shop and see a real joint log?
items.a: Visits start once [shop and test bay ready for visits], in [shop location, city and province]. Audit our quality system from [quality system ready for audit, date]. As a new company, we show a [specimen joint log].

items.q: What certificates come with the PP resin and pipe?
items.a: [PP material certificates] for each lot, with conformity to [PP material standard]. We check each polypropylene (PP) lot's marking against its certificate on receipt.

items.q: Who is qualified to make a joint?
items.a: Only welders qualified to [welder qualification standard for thermoplastics], on the joining method they use. Their qualifications are in the dossier.

items.q: What happens to a rejected joint?
items.a: It is cut out and remade to [PP joint repair rule], under a new number. Rejection rate reported: [joint rejection rate reported, yes or no].

items.q: How is a PP loop cleaned before first use?
items.a: [pre-commissioning flush and cleaning procedure for PP]. The final rinse is Purified Water (PW), run to conductivity and total organic carbon (TOC) limits and recorded.
